name: domain-hound
description: Check domain availability and prices, and screen product names, from your AI assistant.

interface.longDescription: Domain Hound checks registry availability, compares upfront and renewal prices, and screens product names for trademarks, app store clashes and web traction. It can watch a domain for release. Connect your own Spaceship account to get a live quote and set up website or mail DNS. You buy through Spaceship’s own MCP, after you approve Spaceship’s confirmation with the price and payment method. Direct purchase is an opt-in in the server settings, and Spaceship checkout is the fallback. Domain Hound runs on your machine and is open source under the MIT license.
